column1: Prepare these files before testing the document uploads. Use sample or blank documents, not anyone's real ID or certificate. The size limit is 5 MB, which is 5,120 KB or 5,242,880 bytes. Copy every file to the test phone before testing: PDFs and other documents to Files / Downloads, and images to Photos (gallery) so they can be picked from either place.
